behavior: Discovery snapshot, instance/endpoint/protocol/kind/executable/template identity and disabled model IDs persist in one CAS provider write. API keys keep existing Windows DPAPI protection; inventory itself is configuration JSON, not an encryption claim.

Only recognized matching source API/OpenRouter templates receive the fixed pinned flagship defaults. Newly discovered nonflagships are hidden; prior choices and saved conversation/preset selections survive.

Durable snapshots supersede legacy Settings modelCatalogs. A matching legacy catalog migrates only when the provider dialog is explicitly saved. Endpoint changes invalidate the inventory with an incomplete marker that prevents legacy resurrection.

Complete discovery with zero enabled models can be saved with an empty API default. Models can then enable a choice and the actual composer can select it. Undiscovered/invalid/incomplete configurations do not receive that exception.

New complete pagination guard rejects has_more true without a usable cursor, has_more of the wrong type, and wrong-type Google nextPageToken; repeated-cursor and malformed-response checks remain existing tested behavior.

limits: No claim of full model-management parity: curated catalog entries absent from discovery, vendor groups, custom-model CRUD/options/headers and pricing/capability cards remain deferred.
Pinned model IDs are source data, not claims about current availability or entitlement. No account quota verification occurs.
Existing imported/legacy providers without explicit matching template provenance remain uncurated; vendor identity is not guessed from labels or arbitrary endpoints.
Inventory is bounded to 10000 sanitized entries and the existing provider-file aggregate 4 MiB limit; malformed/oversized saves preserve original data. No automatic snapshot truncation.
Context limits remain unknown when not provided; this does not adopt the source 128k fallback or change compression defaults.
Runtime suites used the isolated pre-Claude application snapshot. The current Claude-aware narrow merge separately compiled and applies cleanly; root combined runtime tests are pending.
